It maps one controlled text-change specification to the existing writing preparation, preserving that method and its evidence.
Expected outputs are a concise finding, pinned evidence/original snapshot, and a committed-input Python checker.
One benchmark/default/high session has 90 minutes and 70 turns, with no dependency edges or shared-file conflicts.
Native LabVIEW results, benchmark readiness, product quality and method acceptance remain unestablished.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) records the blocker, graph, review path and conditions for reopening POC work.
Verification here is structural readback; this role has no shell. The ordered task supplies its own offline verification command.

## What next
Execute the task, then inspect its saved verdict and original-source pins; a supported candidate needs a separate pinned reviewer session.
Avoid repeating replay, pin creation, unchanged-source searches or the completed synthetic writing extension.
